The '''Ebiwaan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Ebiwaan]].<ref name="GG9" />

The Ebiwaan system was the endpoint of the [[Leisure Corridor]], a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] and tourism [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] that started at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' originally suggested that Ebiwaan was situated in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Middle Rim]].<ref name="GG9" /> ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'' later indicated that Ebiwaan was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> Eventually, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ebiwaan system in the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
